sopa-notes: Security of payment rules. A subcontractor statement is required before any progress payment release. Insurance certificate of currency must cover workers compensation and public liability for the full contract period. Expired coverage blocks payment by law.
gst-rules: Goods and services tax is ten percent. A business activity statement separates gst from supply charges every quarter. A valid tax invoice shows the gst line separately from the subtotal. Credits reduce the taxable amount before gst is calculated.
journal-howto: Journal entry format for enterprise resource planning posting. Debit the expense account. Credit accounts payable. Attach the supplier invoice and the lease recovery clause. Post to Yardi Voyager under the lot cost centre after reconciliation.
docket-guide: Delivery docket intake from site supervisors. Tipper truck dockets record gravel tonnage. Concrete pour dockets record volume and batch time. Hire hours dockets record machine hours. Each docket is matched to its purchase order before the progress claim is approved.
mbs-note: Medicare schedule billing rules. Specialist referrals stay valid for twelve months. Restricted item combinations cannot be co-claimed on the same day. Eclipse fund rejection codes map to the failed rule for Medibank, Bupa, and HCF claims.
